EVIL_LIGHT_TOOLKIT.Title: Evilbram Lighting Toolkit
EVIL_LIGHT_TOOLKIT.PresetUsage: Drag a light onto the Scene, or click it to load it into the native V14 palette.
EVIL_LIGHT_TOOLKIT.PresetDragHint: Drag and drop onto the Scene, or click to load into the lighting palette.
EVIL_LIGHT_TOOLKIT.PresetActivated: Preset “{label}” loaded into the V14 lighting palette.
EVIL_LIGHT_TOOLKIT.SceneExteriorHint: Prepare an exterior day/night scene and allow SmallTime to drive darkness when active.
EVIL_LIGHT_TOOLKIT.SceneInteriorHint: Prepare an interior scene compatible with darkness changes and SmallTime.
EVIL_LIGHT_TOOLKIT.SceneDarknessHint: Force total darkness and disable the SmallTime link for this Scene.
EVIL_LIGHT_TOOLKIT.IntroText: Prepare the Scene, set the atmosphere, and place ready-to-use light sources.
EVIL_LIGHT_TOOLKIT.SectionSceneHint: Choose the overall lighting and darkness behavior.
EVIL_LIGHT_TOOLKIT.SectionAtmosphereHint: Manual controls for quickly preparing and checking the result.
EVIL_LIGHT_TOOLKIT.SectionUtilitiesHint: Technical sources that extend or complement visibility without replacing primary lights.
EVIL_LIGHT_TOOLKIT.FooterHint: Select one light on the Scene before exporting it.
EVIL_LIGHT_TOOLKIT.InvalidGridDistance: Grid distance must be greater than 0.
